name: recipe-hero
title: Recipe hero
description: The top of a recipe: the photo, title, stars, prep, cook and servings as one region of facts, and a Jump to recipe link that skips the story.
docs: Pass the title, a photo with its alt, a description, the author (a name, or { name, href }), publishedAt, the rating ({ value, count, href? }), the facts and the diet chips. facts are prep, cook and total in minutes (total is prep plus cook when you leave it out), servings (a number or words) and difficulty; each one you leave out is left out of the row, which is one region named Recipe facts and then the title, so two recipes on a page are told apart. Times are time elements with ISO durations, written "25 min" and spoken "25 minutes". jumpHref is the id of the recipe further down the page. Save reports aria-pressed: pass saved to control it or defaultSaved to start it saved, and onSave(saved) is where you keep it. Print opens the browser's print dialog unless you pass onPrint. Pass locale and timeZone for the numbers and the date, and labels to translate the fixed words. onSave and onPrint are functions, so use the hero inside a Client Component.
